_readme: Photos on the site. To add one: drop the file in images/, add an entry here.
role  — where it goes. 'hero' sits behind the masthead (one only; the first wins).
'panel' fills the background of the panel named in 'target'.
'gallery' joins the scrolling rail near the foot of the page.
target— for role 'panel' only. Currently supported: 'next' (the Next up panel).
focus — CSS object-position. Nudge this if a crop cuts someone's head off.
e.g. '50% 20%' pulls the crop upwards. Default is '50% 50%'.
alt   — read aloud by screen readers. Describe it, don't caption it.
credit— shown small under gallery photos. Leave empty to hide.
Unknown roles are ignored, and a file that fails to load is dropped silently,
so a typo here can never break the page.
